page.title: Matter
page.subtitle: Devices, infrastructure and health of the Matter integration.
page.insecureText: The sidecar is reached over plain http on a non-loopback address. The token travels unencrypted. Use https, or keep the sidecar on the same host.
page.insecureTextReadOnly: The sidecar is reached over plain http on a non-loopback address. The token travels unencrypted. Ask an administrator to check the connection settings.
page.noDeviceAccessText: Your permissions do not include viewing Matter devices. Ask an administrator for "View Matter devices" to see the connection, fabric and backup status.

status.title: Connection status
status.loadError: The status could not be loaded.

hint.not_configured: Enter the sidecar URL and token below to connect.
hint.not_configuredReadOnly: The Matter sidecar is not set up yet. An administrator needs to connect it.
hint.connected: The plugin is connected to the Matter sidecar.
hint.unavailable: The sidecar cannot be reached. Check that it is running and that the URL, port and firewall are correct. Attraccess retries automatically.
hint.unavailableReadOnly: The sidecar cannot be reached. Attraccess retries automatically. If this persists, ask an administrator to check the sidecar and the connection settings.
hint.unauthorized: The sidecar rejected the token. Check the token (also after a rotation) and enter it again.
hint.unauthorizedReadOnly: The sidecar rejected the token. An administrator needs to enter a valid token.
hint.incompatible: The versions do not match. Upgrade or downgrade Attraccess, the Matter plugin or the sidecar to the supported combination shown below.
hint.incompatibleReadOnly: The versions do not match the supported combination shown below. Ask an administrator to upgrade or downgrade Attraccess, the Matter plugin or the sidecar.
hint.misconfigured: The URL, the CA certificate or the TLS setup is invalid. Check the URL and path prefix, and that the CA matches the sidecar certificate.
hint.misconfiguredReadOnly: The URL, the CA certificate or the TLS setup is invalid. Ask an administrator to check the connection settings.
hint.hostVersion: This Attraccess version does not report its version. Upgrade Attraccess to {{attraccess}} or newer.
hint.hostVersionReadOnly: This Attraccess version does not report its version. Ask an administrator to upgrade Attraccess to {{attraccess}} or newer.

form.title: Connection settings
form.urlDescription: Use https for anything but the same host. A path prefix for a reverse proxy is allowed.
form.credentialDescription: The shared service token configured on the sidecar. It is never shown again after saving.
form.credentialReenter: You changed the URL or the CA certificate, so enter the token again. A stored token is only sent to the endpoint it was entered for.
form.caDescription: PEM certificate(s) of a private CA. They are trusted in addition to Node.js's default root certificates, not instead of them.
form.caCleared: The CA certificate will be removed when you save.
form.savedText: The connection settings were saved. The plugin reconnects now.
form.removeText: The URL and token are deleted and the plugin disconnects from the sidecar.
form.loadError: The connection settings could not be loaded.
form.changedElsewhereText: Another administrator saved new connection settings while you were editing. Saving is blocked so nothing is overwritten. Reload to see the current settings and lose your edits.

validation.urlScheme: The URL must start with http:// or https://.
validation.urlInvalid: Enter a valid URL without user name, query or fragment.
validation.credential: The token must be 32 to 512 printable ASCII characters, without spaces.
validation.caShape: Enter one or more PEM certificates (-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----) and nothing else.
validation.caTooLong: The certificate text is larger than 64 KiB.

fabric.title: Fabric & backup
fabric.loadError: The fabric status could not be loaded.

error.key_required: This backup was encrypted with a different recovery key. Enter that recovery key.
error.wrong_key: The recovery key is wrong. Check it and try again.
error.corrupt: The backup is corrupt or has been modified and cannot be used.
error.truncated: The backup is incomplete, probably because the file was cut off. Download it again.
error.incompatible_format: This file is not a backup in a supported format.
error.incompatible_schema: The backup uses a storage schema version that this installation cannot restore.
error.incompatible_migration: The backup was made with a different plugin database version. Install the plugin version that created it.
error.incompatible_version: The plugin version must match the version that created the backup. Install that version first.
error.stage_failed: The sidecar could not prepare the backup. Your installation was left unchanged.
error.fabric_exists: The sidecar already has a fabric.
error.recovery_not_required: The fabric does not need recovery any more.
error.sidecar_not_empty: A new fabric can only be started while the sidecar has no fabric.
error.sidecar_not_initialized: The sidecar has no healthy fabric to accept.
error.insecure_transport: The connection to the sidecar is plain HTTP to another machine. Backups and restores carry fabric secrets, so they need https or a sidecar on this machine.
error.recovery_key_mismatch: That is no longer the current recovery key. Reload the page.
error.no_recovery_key: There is no recovery key yet. Generate one first.
error.file_unreadable: The file could not be read. Choose it again.
error.validation_expired: This check has expired. Validate the backup again.
error.preflight_changed: The sidecar changed since the backup was checked. Validate the backup again.
error.confirmation_required: Type the fabric ID to confirm.
error.pre_restore_backup_failed: The backup of the current fabric failed, so nothing was restored. Your installation was left unchanged.
error.restore_failed: The Matter sidecar could not apply or verify the backup. Your installation was left unchanged.
error.rolled_back: The restore failed and was rolled back. Your installation was left unchanged.
error.rollback_failed: The restore failed and the Matter sidecar could not be rolled back automatically, so its state is unknown. Check the sidecar, then restore the backup again.

blocked.recovery: Not available while the fabric needs recovery.
blocked.noFabric: There is no fabric to back up yet.
blocked.insecure: Needs https or a sidecar on this machine: the connection is plain HTTP to another machine.

fabric.unreachableText: The fabric state is unknown until the plugin is connected to the sidecar.
fabric.recoveryRequired: The fabric does not match this installation

storageReason.storage_unreadable: The sidecar cannot read its storage.
storageReason.schema_mismatch: The sidecar's storage has a different schema version.
storageReason.metadata_missing: The sidecar's storage metadata is missing.
storageReason.metadata_orphaned: The sidecar's storage metadata has no fabric data.
storageReason.restore_interrupted: A restore was interrupted. The previous storage was kept; restore a backup.

mismatch.unknown: The sidecar's fabric differs from what Attraccess recorded.
mismatch.sidecar_uninitialized: Attraccess knows a fabric, but the sidecar has none. Its storage was probably lost or replaced.
mismatch.fabric_changed: The sidecar runs a different fabric than the one Attraccess recorded.
mismatch.generation_behind: The sidecar's fabric is older than what Attraccess recorded. Its storage was probably restored from an old copy.
mismatch.generation_ahead: The sidecar's fabric is newer than what Attraccess recorded. The sidecar changed without Attraccess.
mismatch.storage_instance_changed: The sidecar's storage is a different instance than the one Attraccess recorded.
mismatch.sidecar_recovery_required: The sidecar reports that it needs recovery.

fabric.uninitializedText: The sidecar has no fabric yet. Create it to start commissioning devices.
fabric.uninitializedTextReadOnly: The sidecar has no fabric yet. An administrator needs to create it before devices can be commissioned.
fabric.createHint: Creates the Matter fabric on the sidecar, a recovery key and the first backup.
fabric.restoreInstead: Do you already have a backup of a Matter fabric, for example after reinstalling? Restore it instead of creating a new fabric, so devices stay controllable.
fabric.createError: The fabric could not be created

key.title: Your recovery key
key.warning: This key decrypts your backups. Without it, a backup cannot be restored. Attraccess cannot show it again. Store it somewhere safe, apart from the backups.
key.copyFailed: Copying failed. Select the key and copy it manually.
key.fileHeader: Attraccess Matter recovery key. Keep it secret and safe.
key.acknowledge: I have stored the recovery key in a safe place.
key.missingText: Backups are encrypted with a recovery key. Generate one to enable backups.
key.missingTextReadOnly: Backups are encrypted with a recovery key. Until an administrator generates one, no backups are made.
key.generateError: The recovery key could not be generated
key.unacknowledgedText: A recovery key was generated, but you did not confirm that you stored it. It cannot be shown again. Rotate it to get a new one.
key.unacknowledgedTextReadOnly: A recovery key was generated, but nobody confirmed that it was stored. An administrator needs to rotate it.
key.rotateText: A new key encrypts future backups. Existing backups still need the old key, so keep it until they are replaced. The new key is shown once.
key.rotateError: The recovery key could not be rotated

backups.title: Backups

reason.inconsistent: The sidecar and the plugin disagree about the fabric, so no consistent backup can be made.
reason.sidecar_unavailable: The Matter sidecar could not be reached.
reason.sidecar_busy: The Matter sidecar is busy with another operation (a backup, restore, commissioning, removal or share). Try again shortly.
reason.insecure_transport: Backups are refused over a plain HTTP connection to a remote sidecar. Use https or a local connection.
reason.no_recovery_key: There is no recovery key yet.
reason.recovery_key_unreadable: The stored recovery key cannot be read by this installation.
reason.recovery_required: The fabric needs recovery first. No backup is made in this state.
reason.no_fabric: There is no fabric to back up.
reason.sidecar_error: The Matter sidecar could not produce a snapshot.
reason.internal: The backup failed because of an internal error.

backups.downloadError: The backup could not be downloaded
backups.retention: The latest {{count}} backups are kept. Backup files are encrypted and need the recovery key to restore.

restore.title: Restore from backup
restore.intro: Validate a backup first. Nothing changes until you confirm.
restore.recoveryKeyHint: The key this backup was encrypted with.

error.empty: The file is empty. Choose the backup file you downloaded.
error.tooLarge: The file is too large to upload here (at most 7 MB). Restore from a stored backup instead.

kind.rollback: Roll back to an earlier state

restore.previewHint: The backup is valid. Restoring replaces the fabric and the plugin's Matter data with the backup.
restore.previewHintBackup: A backup of the current state is taken first.
restore.overwriteText: The sidecar currently runs a healthy fabric. Restoring replaces it. Devices commissioned after the backup was made will be lost and must be commissioned again.
restore.typeFabricId: Type the current fabric ID {{fabricId}} to confirm
restore.running: Restoring. Do not close this page.
restore.successText: The fabric and the plugin data were restored and verified.
restore.fromStoredHint: One of the backups this installation keeps.
restore.fromUploadHint: A backup file you downloaded, for example after reinstalling.
restore.rollbackFailedTitle: The restore failed and could not be rolled back
restore.inconsistentTitle: This backup was taken during recovery
restore.inconsistentText: When it was taken, the plugin's data and the sidecar's fabric did not match. Restoring it brings that mismatch back, and you will have to settle the recovery again afterwards.

recovery.title: Recovery
recovery.blockedText: Until you choose how to recover, creating a fabric and other fabric changes are blocked. Nothing is changed automatically.
recovery.restoreText: Bring back the fabric and data from a stored or uploaded backup.
recovery.acceptText: Treat the fabric the sidecar runs now as the correct one.
recovery.acceptUnavailable: Only available while the sidecar runs a healthy fabric.
recovery.acceptConfirmText: Attraccess will treat the sidecar's current fabric as authoritative and forget what it recorded before. Devices tied to the old fabric are no longer controllable.
recovery.newUnavailable: Only available while the sidecar has no fabric.
recovery.newConfirmText: Every device commissioned before must be factory-reset and commissioned again, because it belongs to the old fabric. This cannot be undone.

error.busy: The Matter sidecar is busy with another operation (a backup, restore, commissioning, removal or share). Try again shortly.
error.sidecar_unavailable: The sidecar cannot be reached. Try again when it is connected.
error.sidecar_error: The Matter sidecar refused the request.
error.recovery_required: The fabric needs recovery first. Restore a backup, accept the sidecar's fabric or start a new fabric.
error.network: The server could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
error.not_found: This no longer exists. Reload the page.
error.invalid_code: The setup code is not valid. Check it and enter it again.
error.fabric_absent: The Matter sidecar has no fabric yet. Create the fabric on the Infrastructure tab first.
error.fabric_mismatch: The device does not belong to the sidecar's current fabric. Nothing was changed.
error.node_not_on_sidecar: The Matter sidecar does not know this device. Nothing was changed. Run a reconciliation on the Devices tab.
error.not_shareable: Only a claimed device in the fabric can be shared.
error.not_removable: This device cannot be removed from the fabric in its current state. Reload the page.
error.not_succeeded: Only a device that was added can be named.
error.already_finished: This device was already named. Open it to change its names.
error.node_removed: The device was removed in the meantime.
error.insecure_transport: The connection to the Matter sidecar is plain HTTP to another machine. Setup and sharing codes are secrets, so this needs https or a sidecar on this machine.
error.device_unreachable: The device could not be reached. Nothing was changed.
error.timeout: The device did not answer in time.
error.registry_failed: The device left the fabric, but its Attraccess record could not be updated. A reconciliation runs now; check the device again in a moment.
error.attestation_override_disabled: The Matter sidecar does not allow the attestation override. An operator enables it on a development install only.
error.unsupported_capability: This Matter sidecar release cannot do this yet. Update the sidecar.

notAvailable.available: The sidecar supports "{{family}}", but this plugin version does not use it yet. It comes with a later plugin version.
notAvailable.unavailable: The sidecar does not report "{{family}}" as available. It comes with a later plugin version, and needs a sidecar that supports it.
notAvailable.unknown: The sidecar is not connected, so its "{{family}}" support is unknown. This part comes with a later plugin version.
notAvailable.noStatus: This part comes with a later plugin version. Whether the sidecar supports "{{family}}" is not shown here.

thread.emptyText: No Thread network, Border Router or dataset is shown yet. This page will show them once Thread support is available.
thread.coexistenceText: Thread and Zigbee share the 2.4 GHz band with Wi-Fi. Plan the channels so they do not overlap: keep Thread and Zigbee at least a few channels apart, and away from the busiest Wi-Fi channels. Changing the channel later means re-joining devices, so decide before you build the network.

dataset.title: Dataset
dataset.text: The Thread dataset status (network name and channel, never the keys) appears here.

borderRouters.title: Border Routers
borderRouters.text: Border Routers (OTBR) of your Thread network and their state appear here.

rcps.title: RCPs
rcps.text: Radio co-processors that serve as Thread radios, with their state, appear here.

smlight.title: SMLIGHT diagnostics
smlight.text: Diagnostics of SMLIGHT radios, such as firmware and channel use, appear here.

commissioning.emptyText: Adding devices needs a sidecar that supports commissioning. Nothing here collects or sends a setup code until it does.

prepare.text: Make sure the device is on the network (Ethernet or Wi-Fi) and ready to pair: new, factory-reset, or with a pairing window opened by its other controller.

code.text: Enter the setup code or scan the QR code printed on the device or its packaging.

progress.text: Attraccess shows each commissioning step and tells you what to do if one fails.

finish.text: Give the new device a name and a location. It is already claimed by you and can be used in flows.

prepare.title: Prepare the device
prepare.network: The device must already be on the network (Ethernet or Wi-Fi) and reachable from the Matter sidecar.
prepare.window: A new device is ready out of the box or after a factory reset. A device that already belongs to another ecosystem needs a sharing code from that ecosystem ("Share" or "Turn on pairing mode").
prepare.code: Keep the setup code at hand: the QR code or the 11 or 21 digit number printed on the device or its packaging.
prepare.sharing: A sharing code from Apple Home, Google Home, SmartThings or Home Assistant works like a setup code and is entered the same way.

code.label: Setup code or sharing code
code.hint: Paste the QR text (MT:…) or type the 11 or 21 digit number. Spaces and hyphens are ignored. The code is checked here and never saved.

problem.format: This is not a Matter setup code. Use the QR text starting with MT: or the 11 or 21 digit number.
problem.checksum: The check digit does not match. Check the number for a typo.

code.title: Enter or scan the setup code

insecure.title: The camera is not available
insecure.text: Browsers allow the camera only on HTTPS or localhost. Upload a picture of the QR code or type the code instead.

denied.title: The camera could not be opened
denied.text: Allow camera access for this site, or upload a picture of the QR code or type the code instead.

image.label: Picture of the QR code
image.hint: The picture is read in this browser. It is not uploaded and not stored.
image.failedText: The picture could not be read as a QR code. Try a sharper, closer picture, or type the code.
image.tooLargeText: Pictures up to 20 MB and 40 megapixels are read here. Use a smaller or cropped picture of the QR code, or type the code.

progress.title: Commissioning in progress
progress.hint: This can take a few minutes. Keep the device powered and close to the network.
progress.cancelText: The device is not added. You can start again with the code.

step.pase: Secure pairing with the setup code
step.adding_fabric: Adding the device to the Attraccess fabric

openAction.repair: Open the device to repair it
openAction.restore: Open the device to restore it
openAction.claim: Open the device to claim it

unknown.title: Commissioning failed
unknown.text: The device was not added. Start again with the code.

invalid_code.title: The setup code is not valid
invalid_code.text: The sidecar could not read this code. Check it and enter it again.

device_not_found.title: The device was not found
device_not_found.text: Bring the device closer or onto the same network as the Matter sidecar, make sure its pairing window is open, and start again.

pase_failed.title: The code was not accepted
pase_failed.text: The device did not accept the passcode. Check the code for typos, or open a new pairing window on the device, and start again.

attestation_failed.title: The device could not be verified
attestation_failed.text: The device certificate is not trusted, so it was not added. Nothing was changed on the device.

already_commissioned.title: This device is already in the Attraccess fabric
already_commissioned.open: It is already known here. Open it.
already_commissioned.repair: It is known but detached. Open it and repair it.
already_commissioned.restore: It is known but archived. Open it and restore it.
already_commissioned.reconcile: Run a reconciliation on the Devices tab to find it, or factory-reset the device and add it again.
already_commissioned.claim: It is known here but not claimed yet. Open it and claim it.

fabric_full.title: The device has no room for another administrator
fabric_full.text: The device cannot join another fabric. Remove it from one of its other controllers, or factory-reset it, and start again.

case_failed.title: The secure connection failed
case_failed.text: The device joined, but the connection could not be completed. Check the device is on the network and start again.

timeout.title: Commissioning took too long
timeout.text: The device did not finish in time. Nothing was left half-registered. Start again.

interrupted.title: Commissioning was interrupted
interrupted.text: The Matter sidecar or the plugin restarted, or the connection dropped. A session is never resumed. If the device had already joined, check Devices: it appears there as an unclaimed device. Otherwise start again with the code.

internal.title: Commissioning failed
internal.text: An unexpected error stopped commissioning. Start again.

needs_reconciliation.title: The device joined but is not registered yet
needs_reconciliation.text: The device is in the fabric, but Attraccess could not record it. Open Devices: after the next reconciliation it appears as an unclaimed device.

registry_failed.title: The device joined but could not be recorded
registry_failed.text: The device is in the fabric, but Attraccess could not store it. Open Devices: after the next reconciliation it appears as an unclaimed device.

override.title: Add the device without verification?
override.risk: This device failed attestation: its certificate is not trusted. Adding it anyway lets an unverified or counterfeit device into your fabric. Only do this for a device you built or trust, on a development system. The attempt is recorded in the audit log.
override.acknowledge: I understand the risk and want to add this device without verification.
override.failed: The new attempt could not start

finish.addedText: It is in the Attraccess fabric and already claimed by you.
finish.overridden: Attestation was overridden: the device is shown as not verified.
finish.title: Name the device
finish.name: Device name
finish.endpointsHint: Optional. Empty names stay as they are.
finish.failed: The names could not be saved

updates.emptyTitle: Update discovery is not available yet
updates.emptyText: Finding, approving and applying device software updates comes with OTA support. Until then, this page lists the software each device runs now.

devices.noDevices: No Matter devices yet. Devices appear here once they are commissioned and the sidecar reports them.
devices.loadError: The devices could not be loaded.
devices.detailError: The device could not be loaded.
devices.refreshError: The device could not be refreshed.

unclaimed.title: Unclaimed device
unclaimed.text: This device is in the fabric but nobody has taken responsibility for it. It cannot be used in flows until an administrator claims it. Claim it, or archive or remove it if it does not belong here.

detached.title: Detached device
detached.text: This device is no longer connected to its record. It cannot be used until you repair or relink it.

reason.absent_from_sidecar: The sidecar no longer lists it.
reason.fabric_mismatch: The fabric of the sidecar changed.
reason.fabric_absent: Its fabric is not known to the sidecar.

claim.title: Claim device
claim.text: Claiming makes this device part of your installation, so it can be used in flows.
claim.name: Name (optional)
claim.nameHint: At most 100 characters. You can change it later.

relink.title: Relink device
relink.text: Choose the unclaimed device that replaced this one. The detached record takes over its identity and state and keeps its name and its use in flows.
relink.none: There is no unclaimed device to relink to.
relink.mismatchText: These details differ between the two devices: {{fields}}. Relinking anyway transfers this record to a different device. Only continue if you are sure.

repair.title: Repair {{name}}?
repair.text: The device is read from the sidecar again. If the sidecar still lists it, the record is reconnected.

archive.title: Archive {{name}}?
archive.text: An archived device is hidden from the list and cannot be used. You can restore it later.

restore.title: Restore {{name}}?
restore.text: The device returns as detached. The next reconciliation reconnects it if the sidecar still lists it.

forceRemove.title: Force remove {{name}}?
forceRemove.text: This removes the device from Attraccess only. It does not factory-reset the device and does not remove it from the Matter fabric. If the sidecar still lists it, it comes back as a new unclaimed device.

reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
reconciliation.loadError: The reconciliation status could not be loaded.

stale.title: Live updates are unavailable
stale.text: What you see may be out of date. The page refreshes itself regularly until live updates work again.

metadata.title: Name and location
metadata.claimFirst: Claim the device to name it.
metadata.resolveFirst: Repair or relink the device to edit it.

attestation.overriddenNote: Attestation was overridden when the device was added.

state.loadError: The state could not be loaded.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.text: Raw device types, cluster, attribute and command IDs and capabilities, for support. You do not need them to use a device.

removed_from_fabric.title: Removed from the Attraccess fabric
removed_from_fabric.text: The device left the Attraccess fabric. Its history is kept. Other controllers are not affected. The device was not factory-reset.

forced_from_fabric.title: Forgotten by Attraccess
forced_from_fabric.text: Attraccess forgot this device without contacting it. The device may still hold Attraccess credentials: factory-reset it or remove it from its other controller. Its history is kept.

force_removed.title: Removed from Attraccess only
force_removed.text: This record was removed from Attraccess without contacting the device. The device is still in the Matter fabric: if the sidecar still lists it, it comes back as a new unclaimed device. Its history is kept.

merged.title: Merged into another device
merged.text: This record was relinked into a detached device, which now carries its identity and endpoints. Its history is kept.

replaced.title: Replaced
replaced.text: This record was replaced by a newer record of the same device. Its history is kept.

generic.title: Removed
generic.text: This device is no longer used in Attraccess. Its history is kept.

remove.confirmText: Attraccess asks the device to leave the Attraccess fabric and then forgets it. Other controllers keep the device. This is not a factory reset. History is kept.
remove.forceText: Attraccess forgets the device without contacting it. The device may still hold Attraccess credentials. Factory-reset it, or remove it from its other controller, so it does not stay a member of the Attraccess fabric. History is kept.
remove.failed: The device could not be removed
remove.unreachableTitle: The device could not be reached
remove.unreachableText: Nothing was changed. If the device is gone or broken, you can force remove it.
remove.timeoutTitle: The device did not confirm the removal in time
remove.timeoutText: The outcome is uncertain: the device may still leave the fabric. A reconciliation runs now. Check this page again before you force remove the device.
remove.detachedHint: The Matter sidecar does not know this detached device. Repair or relink it first; then it can be removed from the fabric.

error.node_not_on_sidecar: The Matter sidecar does not know this device, so it cannot be removed from the fabric. Nothing was changed. Run a reconciliation, or use “Force remove” among the device actions to remove only its record from Attraccess.

share.title: Share with another controller
share.text: Opens a pairing window so Apple Home, Google Home, Home Assistant or another controller can add this device as well. Attraccess keeps its own access.
share.confirmText: A one-time code opens a pairing window for a few minutes. Anyone who has the code during that time can add the device to another ecosystem.
share.once: This code is shown only once and is not stored.
share.expiredText: The pairing window ended. Share again to get a new code.

administrators.title: Managed outside Attraccess
administrators.text: Other controllers that this device is joined to. Attraccess only lists them. Nothing they do is shown as an action of an Attraccess user.

compatibility.title: Compatibility
compatibility.noVersions: No version is known yet. It appears when the sidecar connects.
compatibility.versionsLastKnown: Last known: sidecar {{sidecar}}, matter.js {{matterJs}}, wire version {{wire}}.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.unknown: Capabilities are known while the sidecar is connected.

text.ok: The sidecar has the fabric the plugin recorded.
text.recovery: The plugin and the sidecar disagree about the fabric. Choose how to recover in Infrastructure.
text.unreachable: The fabric cannot be checked while the sidecar is unreachable.
text.uninitialized: The sidecar has no fabric yet. Create one in Infrastructure.
text.unknown: The fabric status is not known.

reconciliation.title: Reconciliation and events
reconciliation.noEvents: No device events applied or ignored since the plugin started.

thread.title: Thread
thread.text: Thread health (Border Routers, radios) appears here once Thread support is available.
